description: The on-submit list of what the form rejected: focusable, counted, and each row links to its own field. Render it above the first field. Copy: the title counts the problems and nothing else — "2 things need fixing". Each row repeats the field's own error word for word, because a summary that paraphrases sends the reader hunting for a message that does not exist.

props.name: errors
props.description: The failures of the last submit, in the order the fields appear.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the list. Defaults to the count in the current language.

example:
const [email, setEmail] = useState('teamlead.example.com')const [errors, setErrors] = useState<FormError[]>(REJECTED)const submit = () => {
  setErrors(email.includes('@') ? [] : REJECTED)
}

<FormStack>
  <ErrorSummary errors={errors} />
  <Field
    label="Email address"
    htmlFor="invite-email"
    required
    error={errors.length ? 'Enter an email address with an @ in it' : undefined}
  >
    <Input
      id="invite-email"
      type="email"
      autoComplete="email"
      value={email}
      invalid={errors.length > 0}
      onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
    />
  </Field>
  <Row>
    <Button onClick={submit}>Send invite</Button>
  </Row>
</FormStack>
